summary: Cannae Holdings filed an 8-K on November 4, 2026, disclosing that directors Woodrow Tyler and Mark Linehan will not stand for re-election at the December 11, 2026 annual meeting, citing no disagreement with the company. The board set its post-meeting size at ten members and approved accelerating vesting of unvested restricted stock and equity awards for any director who resigns or declines re-election. A November 5 letter notified directors of the change. No terms, advisors or regulatory clocks are disclosed; watch board composition and governance signals.
